info.title: CloudAMQP Customer API (baton-cloudamqp surface)
info.description: The subset of the CloudAMQP Customer API that baton-cloudamqp calls. Scope is connector scope: four operations, and only the response fields the connector's structs declare. Role values are taken from https://www.cloudamqp.com/docs/cloudamqp-user-access-control.html (accessed 2026-09-22), which documents the same six roles the connector enumerates in pkg/connector/role.go.

servers.description: Default base URL (pkg/cloudamqp/client.go DefaultBaseURL). Overridable via the connector's base-url config field.

get.description: pkg/cloudamqp/client.go GetUsers. Returns the whole team in one response -- CloudAMQP does not paginate this endpoint and the connector sends no page or cursor parameters. GetUserByEmail and GetUserByID both call this and filter client-side, because the API has no per-user lookup.

200.description: Every member of the team. The array is the whole body, not wrapped in an envelope.

put.description: pkg/cloudamqp/client.go UpdateUserRole. Body is form-encoded, not JSON. The connector does not decode the response.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The member's id, as returned by listTeamMembers.

200.description: Role updated. The connector passes a nil response target and does not decode the body.

post.description: pkg/cloudamqp/client.go InviteUser. Body is form-encoded. The invitee must accept the emailed invitation before appearing in listTeamMembers, so a successful call does not immediately produce a member.

tags[].description: Instance tags restricting the member's access. Sent as repeated tags[] fields so the server receives an array. Per CloudAMQP's docs, tags restrict which instances the member and monitor roles can reach.

200.description: Invitation sent. The connector does not decode the body.

400.description: Duplicate invite or malformed email. CloudAMQP uses 400 for both rather than 409.

post.description: pkg/cloudamqp/client.go RemoveUser. POST, not DELETE, and the member is addressed by email rather than id. CloudAMQP has no soft-disable, so this is a hard removal.

200.description: Member removed. The connector does not decode the body.

ApiKeyBasic.description: HTTP Basic with an empty username and the Customer API key as the password (pkg/cloudamqp/client.go constructAuth). The key is issued from the API Access page in the CloudAMQP console.

Error.description: Error. Any status >= 300 is turned into an APIError by pkg/cloudamqp/helpers.go newAPIError, which carries the status code and the raw body.

TeamMember.description: Only the fields baton-cloudamqp reads. id is the user resource ID; email is the ExternalId provisioning addresses members by.

roles.description: Roles held by this member. Modelled as an array because the connector decodes []string, though the write side sets a single role.

Role.description: Team access role. The six values are documented at cloudamqp.com/docs/cloudamqp-user-access-control.html and enumerated in pkg/connector/role.go as teamAccessRoles.

ApiError.description: Error body shape is not documented and the connector does not decode individual fields -- it records the status code and the raw body. Modelled as an open object rather than guessed at.
